headline: Hearing on fine and suspension for Beverly Gulf Gas over kratom sales, plus tattoo permit reviews at Good Mojo Tattoos.
summary: Other items include an update on opioid settlement funds from Purdue. Rules for artists licensed in other jurisdictions are also up for review.
items: Tobacco violation hearing for Beverly Gulf Gas, 443 Essex Street, including kratom sales and an appeal of fine and suspension
Body art apprentice permit hearing for Estelle Harris, Good Mojo Tattoos [BAP-26-3]
Questions from Good Mojo Tattoos owners Mark Hatch and Loki Chapelle about permit approval conditions for Renee Mandrake [BAP-26-2]
Appeal of conditional approval requirements for Renee Mandrake's permit [BAP-26-2], voted on July 22, 2026
Review of rules for artists licensed in other jurisdictions and possible gaps in current regulations
Opioid settlement funds update on Purdue funds
Departmental updates: director reports, public health nurse updates, and board member topic requests
